cover_prompt: Full-color illustration for a coloring book cover, SQUARE format (1:1 aspect ratio), rich Art Deco style with a luxurious 1920s aesthetic. Ornate columns with fluted details flank the sides. A stylized peacock with a fanning tail made of concentric geometric arcs sits prominently in the lower center. The color palette features gold, emerald green, deep burgundy, midnight blue, and ivory. Premium, elegant, and eye-catching. Text on cover: title 'Art Deco Geometric' and subtitle below. Must state 'Coloring Book for Adults'.
